title: Building Presentation Intelligence for High-Quality Slide Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.30888v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: PowerPoint presentations (PPTs) are a dominant medium for communication across diverse domains, yet high-quality PPT generation still depends heavily on labor-intensive human effort. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) for agentic tasks have created both new opportunities and challenges (Chen et al., 2026) for automatic PPT generation. In this work, we present a unified training framework for automatic PPT generation toward presentation intelligence, integrating cross-validated data synthesis, guided teacher enhancement, and verifiable reward optimization. We first construct a cross-validated pipeline for data synthesis, with explicit control over both difficulty and validity. We then develop a teacher-enhancement framework grounded in rules and prior knowledge to substantially strengthen the instructional capacity of teacher models. translated_title: 构建面向高质量幻灯片生成的演示智能
translated_abstract: PowerPoint演示文稿（PPT）是各个领域中沟通的主流媒介，然而高质量的PPT生成仍然严重依赖大量的人力投入。大语言模型（LLM）在智能体任务方面的最新进展为自动PPT生成带来了新的机遇与挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个面向演示智能的自动PPT生成统一训练框架，该框架集成了交叉验证的数据合成、引导式教师增强以及可验证奖励优化。我们首先构建了一个交叉验证的数据合成流程，能够对难度和有效性进行显式控制。随后，我们开发了一个基于规则和先验知识的教师增强框架，以显著增强教师模型的指导能力。在此基础上，我们通过混合教师策略进一步改进了监督微调（SFT）……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个面向演示智能的统一训练框架，通过交叉验证的数据合成、基于规则与先验知识的教师增强以及可验证奖励优化，实现高质量的自动PPT生成。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a unified training framework for presentation intelligence that integrates cross-validated data synthesis, guided teacher enhancement, and verifiable reward optimization to achieve high-quality automatic PPT generation.
